english.title: Admit / permit spectator to be admitted or remain at a designated football match when no licence in force
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were a responsible person when

(A)_[a person was admitted as a spectator to]_
(B)_[persons were admitted persons as spectators to]_
(C)_[a person was permitted to remain as a spectator on]_
(D)_[persons were permitted to remain as spectators on]_

premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), during a period relevant to a designated football match, namely **(..SPECIFY MATCH..), without a licence to admit spectators being in force
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9 of the Football Spectators Act 1989.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
responsible person
admitted persons as spectators to /
permitted persons to remain as spectators on
premises during a period relevant to a designated football match
when no licence to admit spectators was in force

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where a person is charged with an offence under this section it shall be a defence to prove either that the spectators were admitted in an emergency or (a) that the spectators were admitted without his consent; and (b) that he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of such an offence - Section 9(2)

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
